en.t: To the south, ranges of mountains rose one behind another.

units.source_text: 到达山岭得走三里半地。

en.t: It was three and a half ri to the mountain ridge.

units.source_text: 到港市还得走十一里的路程。

en.t: To reach the port town, there were still eleven ri to go.

units.source_text: 山岭下的峡谷里，雪已经融化。

en.t: In the ravine below the ridge, the snow had already melted.

units.source_text: 也许鹿儿透过树缝间在窥视翻山越岭的大动物呢。

en.t: Perhaps the deer were peering through the gaps in the trees at the large animal crossing the mountains.
